query: I have an 86-year-old female inpatient. Among females 81–91, what's the shortest inpatient duration (days) for hydralazine or isosorbide dinitrate?
final_sql:
SELECT 
  MIN(DATE_DIFF(DATE(dischtime), DATE(admittime), DAY)) AS min_duration_days
FROM 
  `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
INNER JOIN 
  `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
ON 
  p.subject_id = a.subject_id
INNER JOIN 
  `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.prescriptions` pr
ON 
  a.subject_id = pr.subject_id 
  AND a.hadm_id = pr.hadm_id
WHERE 
  p.gender = 'F'
  AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 81 AND 91
  AND (LOWER(pr.drug) LIKE '%hydralazine%' OR LOWER(pr.drug) LIKE '%isosorbide dinitrate%')
  AND a.hospital_expire_flag = 0
  AND a.dischtime > a.admittime;
